# Papers With Lean

> A daily-updated index of papers that use Lean, the interactive theorem
> prover (and Mathlib): arXiv papers screened by an LLM relevance gate (so the
> list is Lean-specific, not colloquial "lean"), plus Lean-verified results from
> the Palomar registry (https://palomar-registry.org). A Palomar result that is
> the same work as a listed arXiv paper is not listed twice; the arXiv entry
> links to it instead. 986 entries as of 2026-09-29.

## Structured data (start here)

- [Full dataset (JSON)](https://paperswithlean.com/site_papers.json): every paper as a JSON
  object. Shape: `{"generated": "YYYY-MM-DD", "papers": [{...}]}`. Each paper
  has: `id` (arXiv id, or a Palomar id `PALOMAR-YYYY-MM-DD-NNNNNN`), `title`,
  `authors` (list), `abstract`, `abs_url` (arXiv abstract or Palomar entry
  page), `pdf_url` (arXiv only), `primary_category`, `published` (YYYY-MM-DD),
  `tags` (list), `lean_note` (one-line description of how the paper uses Lean),
  `repo` (code repo URL if any; for Palomar, the verified pinned commit),
  `thumb` (first-page thumbnail path). Palomar records have `source: "palomar"`
  and `palomar: {trust, theorems}`; arXiv papers verified on Palomar have
  `palomar: [{id, url}]`. Prefer this over scraping the HTML.
- [RSS feed](https://paperswithlean.com/feed.xml): the most recently added papers (recent
  window only, not the full archive).
- [Sitemap](https://paperswithlean.com/sitemap.xml): every page on the site.

## Pages

- [Home / searchable list](https://paperswithlean.com/): client-side search and time filters.
- Per-paper detail pages: `https://paperswithlean.com/paper/<id>.html` (arXiv or Palomar id).
- [Stats](https://paperswithlean.com/stat/): dataset statistics.

## Notes

- Source of truth is `site_papers.json`; the site is rebuilt daily from the
  arXiv API and the Palomar registry plus an LLM relevance/summary pass.
- arXiv and Palomar ids are the stable keys; a paper's detail page is always
  `https://paperswithlean.com/paper/<id>.html`.
